posts.t: Lindy Ruff doesn't have an update on Jiri Kulich yet. He's with the doctor now.
Lindy Ruff doesn't have an update on Kulich. "It didn't look good... He's seeing the doctor now."
Jiri Kulich helped off the ice after he took a puck up high during power play work. Some blood on the ice and Jiri off being tended to
Jiri Kulich just left Sabres practice after taking a puck to the face. A lot of blood on the ice.
Rasmus Dahlin won’t join the Sabres in Montreal, Lindy Ruff said, but he’s progressing. Ruff is hoping Jiri Kulich can get to Montreal tonight and be an option for tomorrow.
Lindy Ruff said Jiri Kulich wasn't feeling well this morning so they sent him back to Buffalo to get checked. All the tests came back negative. He's day to day.
Lindy Ruff said Jiri Kulich wasn’t feeling well this morning. The Sabres sent him back to Buffalo to get some testing done given his history and everything came back ok. He’s day to day.
